description: Hand-kept Fantrax id -> NHL id overrides for fantrax-sync, Slapshot Fantasy League. They win over automatic matching; nhlId null forces 'no match' (player gets the prior). Fantrax ids are platform-wide: a name variant (the NHL spells the player differently) or a namesake is wrong in every league, so those are kept here AND in src/data/fantrax/id-overrides.json (verifier 2026-09-28: with this file empty, Groulx and Zhilkin, both on NHL rosters, and the LAK prospect Jack Hughes had no NHL id here). A match that is only wrong in one league's eligibility vocabulary stays in that league's file alone.
